name: Chimpjar Contact Chat Builder
author: chimpjar

sections.description:
Chimpjar Contact Chat Builder is a lightweight, clean, and highly customizable contact chat widget plugin for WordPress. It helps you connect with your website visitors directly, providing instant support and boosting your sales.

Unlike standard social buttons, this plugin is designed with lead generation in mind. With an intuitive admin interface and a Real-time Live Preview, building your custom chat widget has never been easier!

🌟 Free Features (Lite Version):

  • Live Preview: See exactly how your widget looks in the admin panel before saving.
  • Customizable Design: Change theme colors, position (Bottom Left/Right), and enable/disable the pulse effect.
  • Single Agent Support: Add one primary agent with their Name, Designation, Profile Picture, and Contact Number.
  • Pre-filled Messages: Set up a default message so users can start chatting with one click.
  • Widget Content: Customize the widget title, subtitle, and Call-to-Action (CTA) text.
  • Agent Card Styling: Fully control the background color, text color, border color, and border radius of the agent card.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Zero impact on your website speed. Built with clean Vanilla JS and CSS.

🚀 Unlock Superpowers with PRO Version:

Want to turn your chat widget into a lead generation machine? Upgrade to PRO and get:
* Lead Capture Form: Ask for Name & Email before starting the chat. Save leads directly in the database!
* Unlimited Agents: Add multiple agents (e.g., Sales, Support, Billing).
* Business Hours & Scheduling: Automatically hide agents or show offline messages when you are away.
* Advanced Triggers: Show the widget based on Time Delay, Scroll Depth, or Exit Intent.
* Page Targeting: Show or hide the widget on specific pages, posts, or categories.
* Email Notifications: Get an email alert whenever a user initiates a chat.

Get Chimpjar Contact Chat Builder PRO
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/chimpjar-contact-chat-builder directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Contact Chat in your WordPress admin dashboard menu.
  4. Go to Global Settings to customize the appearance.
  5. Go to Agent Setup to enter your Contact Number (with country code) and agent details.
  6. Click Save Changes and check your website front-end!
sections.faq:
Do I need to include the country code in the phone number?

Yes! Always include the country code without any +, 00, or spaces. For example, if you are from the US, use 1 followed by your number (e.g., 1234567890).

Can I add multiple agents?

The Lite version supports one primary agent. If you want to display a list of multiple agents (Support team, Sales team), you can upgrade to our PRO version.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

Not at all. The plugin is built with clean Vanilla JS and CSS, making it extremely lightweight and fast.

How does the Pre-filled message work?

When a user clicks on your agent, the chat application will open with this pre-filled message already typed in their chat box, ready to be sent.
